added.summary: `og run --shared ws://host:port/ [--shared-token-file f]` gives a native run a static session provider for og.shared: one world server endpoint and the token sent as it is (a self-hosted `og world-server`, or any host's). Without it og.shared.join ends with og.SharedLeft `unavailable`. The run paces itself in real time while a session is open, and its summary carries og.shared.status as `shared`.
